dish out.meaning: Chỉ trích người khác (nhưng không chịu được khi bị chỉ trích lại).
dish out.example: He dishes it out, but gets all hurt when anyone responds.

dish up.example: He dished up a great dinner when we got back.

dive in.meaning: Lao vào làm gì đó (thường không có kế hoạch).
dive in.example: When we saw what was happening, we all dived in to help.
Dinner's on the table, so dive in.

dive into.meaning: Thò tay nhanh vào thứ gì đó.
dive into.example: She dived into her bag and pulled out a lighter.

divvy out.example: The waiters and waitresses divvy out the tips at the end of the night.

divvy up.example: We divvied up the money equally.

diamond in the rough.meaning: Viên ngọc thô (người/vật có tiềm năng nhưng chưa được mài giũa).
diamond in the rough.example: The new intern is a real diamond in the rough; with some training, he could become a great asset to the team.

different strokes for different folks.example: Some people like hiking, while others prefer reading. Different strokes for different folks.

dig in your heels.meaning: Kiên quyết giữ vững lập trường, ngoan cố.
dig in your heels.example: Despite the criticism, she decided to dig in her heels and stick to her plan.

dirt cheap.example: I found this shirt at the market, and it was dirt cheap.

dish the dirt.meaning: Ngồi lê đôi mách, nói xấu người khác.
dish the dirt.example: She loves to dish the dirt about her coworkers.

divide the spoils.example: After the successful business venture, the partners gathered to divide the spoils.
